title: Base change of vector integration counits
statement: For an independently integration-normalized vector purity family, the full prescribed base-change compatibility law holds, with the canonical source comparison and actual exceptional mate. This is one compatibility clause, not the vector-bundle purity theorem.

source.place: paragraph 2; assembly step 3, normalized transpose in the published vector-purity coordinates

proof.text:
Construct the independently normalized family on the Cartesian bundle. Compact-support
projection exchange and geometric trace descent identify the integration counits. Transpose that
equality under the two Brown adjunctions. It is exactly the canonical exceptional base-change
mate, by the mate counit identity. The source associator and both normalized families are
invertible, hence the exceptional exchange is invertible on every tested input. For an arbitrary
Cartesian bundle presentation first identify it with the canonical pullback; the normalized
fundamental class is invariant under this isomorphism. Rank zero uses the unit maps; empty schemes
have unique maps.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 2; the independent base-change portion of vector-bundle purity
